scripts.text:
[Logistics]
Hello?
I am in charge of distributing
reward items for KVM points. Any
wrong selection of items will not
be reversed. Please be carefull.
Select the next step please.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
喂？
我负责发放KVM点数奖励物品。
一旦选错物品，概不退换。
请务必小心。
请选择下一步。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
Here is the catalogue of KVM items.
Each weapon requires 2,000 points
and each armor from 10 to 1,200
points. So, be carefull when
selecting a reward.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
这是KVM物品目录。
每件武器需要2,000点，
每件防具从10点到1,200点不等。
所以，选择奖励时请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
{0}, your current points are ^580080{1}^000000 KVM Points.

[Logistics]
There are 3 categories in KVM Rewards: Weapon/Armor.Accessory.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
KVM奖励分为3个类别：武器、防具、饰品。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
Weapon rewards require 2,000 KVM points for each.
There are 3 types of Armor rewards and they require 840/630/580 KVM points fo each.
Accessory rewards require 1,200 KVM points for each.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
武器奖励每件需要2,000 KVM积分。
防具奖励分为3种，分别需要840/630/580 KVM积分。
饰品奖励每件需要1,200 KVM积分。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
Kreiger Weapons are LV 4 Weapons, they can be upgraded and will have special effects: Slaughter, Destruction and Blessing.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
Kreiger武器是4级武器，它们可以升级并拥有特殊效果：屠杀、破坏和祝福。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
When you can wear all 3 armors, you can have a special set of options.
Also, when Kreiger Accessory rewards are worn with medalsm it will bring you special set rewards.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
当你能同时装备全部3件防具时，可以获得特殊的套装属性。
此外，当Kreiger饰品奖励与奖章一同佩戴时，会为你带来特殊的套装奖励。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
Finally, there are Mass-Production Armor and Accessory rewards.
Players whose Lvl is higher than 60 can equip Mass-Production Armors and there is a Lvl limit for Popularized Armor as well.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
最后，还有量产防具和饰品奖励。
等级高于60级的玩家可以装备量产防具，普及防具也有等级限制。

scripts.text:
[Logistics]
KVM Points are rewarded when you win, lose or draw in Kreiger Von Midgard (KVM).
You can have special Rewards by using these points.
scripts.translation:
[后勤]
在米德加尔特战记(KVM)中，无论胜、负、平都会获得KVM积分。
你可以使用这些积分换取特殊的奖励。
